sections.title: Subject
clauses: Frictionless gears, type *EG-∞*, for the perpetual motion prototype.
Each gear keeps turning once set in motion. A gear that stops is replaced free of charge.

sections.title: Price
clauses: EUR 1.00 per gear, payable once the first gear has turned for a full week.

sections.title: Delivery
clauses: The supplier delivers on the first day of eternity, or on Monday, whichever comes first.

sections.title: General
clauses: Disputes about the second law of thermodynamics are settled by experiment.
